newsitem.title: UK: BAe pays up to $13 mln for SAfrica ATE stake.
newsitem.headline: BAe pays up to $13 mln for SAfrica ATE stake.

text.p: British Aerospace said on Thursday it had bought a 20 percent minority stake in South Africa's private Advanced Technologies & Engineering (ATE) "for a consideration of up to $13.0 million".
Europe's largest defence exporter said it had formed a partnership in avionics and systems integration with ATE.

ATE specialises in integrated avionics systems and also develops Unmanned Airborne Vehicles (UAVs). The deal is expected to create the biggest defence industry alliance between European and South African firms.

Allan Macdonald, BAe managing director for southern Africa, said in Johannesburg that it was hoped that the whole ATE will be integrated into BAe. The integration, however, could take about five years, he said.
